{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Graduate Student Workers at UC Santa Cruz launched a wildcat grading strike on December 9th.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The UC Santa Cruz grading strike was spurred on by the university administration’s responses to students’ requests for a Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA).",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Students at UC Santa Cruz requested a Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) to alleviate rent burden.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The UC Santa Cruz administration responded to students’ requests for a Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) with threats of student conduct discipline for organizing around a COLA.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The UC Santa Cruz administration’s response to students’ requests for a Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) caused the campaign to snowball quickly.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The wildcat strike at UC Santa Cruz is not officially sanctioned.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Students and their organizations at UC Santa Cruz are at greater risk for legal action and termination because of the wildcat strike.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The DSA applauds the militancy of the students at UC Santa Cruz.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The DSA applauds the ambitious demands the students at UC Santa Cruz are putting on their employer.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The working classes will not find victory if they are unable to exercise courage in the face of risks.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
